posts.text: I don’t agree with a lot of what @hasanthehun says. I even have four hour debates with him. So what if we agree on some things and disagree on others? Why do these establishment assholes think they can tell us who we can talk to? I’ll talk to Hasan or anyone else I like. #SuckIt

This idea that you - or others - can’t talk to anyone who you feel is out of bounds is anti-intellectual. It’s an effort to curtail acceptable opinions. It’s not what good or smart people do. It’s what propagandists do to limit conversation to only ideas they’ve pre-approved.
Iran shot down a U.S. fighter jet. Remember when we were promised how easy this would be.

The same lies by the same people. The only ones who wanted this war all work for Israel. Pete Hegseth told us that we had complete control over Iran’s airspace. What happened now? It’s one thing when you lie about how great Trump is, it’s another when your lies get people killed.

Every problem in the Middle East and every war we’ve fought in the past 60 years are all about one thing - the occupation. It’s the cancer that’s causing all these problems. 

People are never going to accept the Israelis brutally occupying the Palestinians forever. And the Israelis are never going to let them go because they’re vicious. 

They don’t want peace, they want more land. And they’re dragging the world through the mud to get what they want. 

And mainstream media is their evil henchme

Pam Bondi was a terrible person who signed up for a fundamentally dishonest job. But she was blamed by Trump for not winning unwinnable cases on his actions that were grossly unconstitutional. And she wasn’t blamed for burying Epstein Files, but for not burying them well enough.

You notice how mainstream media loves to cancel people based on whether they talked to anyone who criticized Israel too harshly. Isn’t it curious how they never do that to people who associate with @LauraLoomer and @marklevinshow? Those two are biggest racists and bigots in US.

That’s because national media LOVES Israel and thinks being racist against Arabs and bigoted against Muslims is perfectly normal. They’re not at all offended by that. Mark Levin is over-the-top hateful and no one in media has ever tried to cancel a politician for talking to him.

Everyone is excited Pam Bondi is gone and it feels good to have a little accountability. But the next person isn’t going to be any better. They’re going to be picked by Trump, loyal to whatever ludicrous thing Trump wants to do, will bury Epstein files and work for the donors.

This is indisputable. It often feels like @RoKhanna is the only Democrat in Washington doing anything. But he has gotten so much done, almost singlehandedly, that it makes you wonder what could get done if all the Democrats tried to take action. Instead, they’re doing nothing.

The Iron Dom is important & saves lives.  Israel should be able to buy it on their own with a $45 defense billion budget. Israel is a first world country, and it can pay for the defensive systems it needs

Bringing our troops home would obviously be worth leaving the war for, on its own, but the icing on the cake would be watching Israel First freak the fuck out. And how hilarious it would be to see the guys who were kissing Trump's ass a minute ago turn around on a dime.

Trump is screwed no matter what now. If he continues the war and puts ground troops in, all the voters will hate him, including huge chunk of his own voters. If he doesn’t continue the war, establishment media will ravage him because they’ll be furious he didn’t listen to Israel.

Israel is now indistinguishable from the Taliban. They’re religious extremists who don’t value the lives of anyone not in their religion and destroy and desecrate anything related to other faiths. They also dug up Muslim and Christian graves in Gaza. We’re funding terrorists.

In @RepThomasMassie primary, we have pure test of mainstream media and billionaire money versus grassroots. Ideology and partisanship are largely removed as factors since it’s within same party. 
  
There’s only one main thing that separates them. One is willing to work for the donors and the other isn’t. One works for Israel and the other is a patriot.

This is a test of the free versus the brainwashed zombies. Can enough propaganda get the people of Kentucky to vote against America and in favo

This might be first real test of political revolution against the establishment. If right-wing populists can’t defend on their home turf of Kentucky and lose the seat to Israel, then the polls are right and MAGA are just 85-95% cult followers of Trump. But I think Massie holds!

Trump keeps saying that he’s going to obliterate Iran AND that he’s going to leave right away. Now, he’s saying he’s going to leave without reopening Strait of Hormuz. What? I’m all for leaving, but wouldn’t we at least negotiate to reopen it? He has no idea what he’s doing!

If you tell the Iranians you might leave without reopening the Strait, then they have all the incentive to wait you out and offer nothing in return. Best deal is that we promise to leave in exchange for reopening Strait. But now, we’ve lost that leverage, too. Total incompetence.

Israeli government officials are sick fascists. It’s an unconscionable moral stain on our country to support Israeli regime. Now, they passed a law to hang Palestinians, that doesn’t apply to Jewish Israelis for the same crimes. It’s insane that our media pretends not to see it.


sarah (@sahouraxo)

Israel just passed a law to execute Palestinians.
